description: Source code for a test tool related to Git submodules, including command implementations for checking submodule name, URL, active status, resolving URLs, and managing submodule configuration.

methods.name: check_submodule
methods.description: Applies a check function to each line of stdin and prints lines that pass the check.

methods.name: cmd__submodule_check_name
methods.description: Handles the 'check-name' subcommand for submodule name validation.

methods.name: cmd__submodule_check_url
methods.description: Handles the 'check-url' subcommand for submodule URL validation.

methods.name: cmd__submodule_is_active
methods.description: Checks if a submodule is active.

methods.name: cmd__submodule_resolve_relative_url
methods.description: Resolves a relative URL for a submodule.

methods.name: cmd__submodule_config_set
methods.description: Sets a submodule configuration key-value pair.

methods.name: cmd__submodule_config_writeable
methods.description: Checks if the .gitmodules file is writable.

methods.name: cmd__submodule
methods.description: Main command dispatcher for submodule-related subcommands.
